m06_159.text:
Review of Harborview Grand Hotel (Stayed October 18–21)
Rated 4 out of 5 stars by Jonathan K.
I stayed at the Harborview Grand while attending the Maritime Logistics Expo nearby. The location is unbeatable—just a four-minute walk from the convention center's west entrance—and the soundproofing in the rooms is impressive, considering how busy the waterfront boulevard gets during rush hour. Check-in was swift thanks to the mobile key feature, and the concierge went out of his way to print last-minute presentation handouts for me at 6:30 A.M.

My only disappointment was the executive breakfast buffet. Although the fresh pastries and made-to-order omelets were delicious, the dining area was severely understaffed on Tuesday morning when two large tour groups arrived simultaneously. Coffee refills took nearly twenty minutes, and several hot trays sat empty for quite a while. If you have an early morning seminar, I'd recommend grabbing coffee at the café across the street instead.

m06_162.text:
Regional Airports Bet on Biometric Boarding
By Claire Bennett, Aviation Correspondent

While major international hubs have spent the past five years installing facial-recognition gates, mid-sized regional airports are now rapidly adopting similar biometric boarding systems. According to a report released Monday by the Regional Air Transport Association (RATA), 42 percent of North American regional airports plan to introduce automated facial-scan boarding lanes within the next 18 months.

"Smaller airports used to assume biometric infrastructure was too costly," said RATA spokesperson Victor Morales. "However, cloud-based software subscriptions have lowered upfront hardware expenses by nearly 60 percent." Early trials in Austin and Portland demonstrated that biometric gates reduced average boarding times for a 150-seat aircraft from 28 minutes to just 16 minutes. Privacy advocates, meanwhile, continue to urge airports to ensure that passenger facial templates are automatically deleted within 24 hours of flight departure.

• 解析：原文 at 4:30 P.M. with a live dessert demonstration by a local pastry chef，正解 (D) 改寫為 Watch a live sweet-making presentation。
• 誘答分析：(B) 酒莊參觀在 4:30 P.M. 之前；(A) 與 (C) 皆為早上與中午行程，屬「時間錯置」陷阱。
• 單字補充：presentation (n.) 展示、示範。

questions.q: Who is the intended audience for this talk?
options: Medical convention organizers
Hotel IT support technicians
Front desk receptionists
Lodging sanitation managers

explain.text:
• 考點：聽眾對象（上位概念替換）。
• 解析：開頭稱呼 housekeeping supervisors（房務主管），對應 (D) Lodging sanitation managers。
• 誘答分析：(C) 挪用 front desk；(A) 挪用 medical convention；(B) 過度推論平板電腦與 IT 的關聯。
• 單字補充：lodging (n.) 旅宿業；sanitation (n.) 清潔衛生。

questions.q: According to the speaker, what has improved over the past quarter?
options: The number of early check-ins requested by convention guests
Accuracy in delivering paper clipboards to the back office
Attendance at the Q3 operational briefing
The speed of preparing suites between guests

explain.text:
• 考點：過去一季改善項目（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 average room turnover time dropped by seven minutes per suite，正解 (D) 改寫為 The speed of preparing suites between guests。
• 誘答分析：(C) 挪用 Q3 operational 與 briefing；(A) 混用 early check-ins；(B) 混用 paper clipboards 與 back office。
• 單字補充：turnover time (n.) 客房整理周轉時間。

questions.q: What new procedure will start next Monday?
options: Recording room readiness on handheld electronic devices
Having supervisors inspect suites seven minutes faster
Replacing front desk notifications with back-office briefings
Logging medical convention check-ins on paper clipboards

explain.text:
• 考點：新規定細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 receive a digital tablet to log room inspections in real time，正解 (A) 改寫為 Recording room readiness on handheld electronic devices。
• 誘答分析：(C) 與原文「即時通知櫃檯」相反；(D) 原文是「淘汰」紙本夾板；(B) 混用 seven minutes。
• 單字補充：handheld (adj.) 手持式的。

questions.q: What is being advertised?
options: A global hotel chain for layover stays
A corporate credit card for frequent travelers
An international airport club program
A high-speed café Wi-Fi subscription

explain.text:
• 考點：廣告產品（同義替換）。
• 解析：廣告介紹 Horizon Elite Lounge Pass 可使用全球四百多間機場貴賓室，對應 (C) An international airport club program。
• 誘答分析：(D) 挪用 café Wi-Fi；(B) 挪用 corporate travelers；(A) 混用 400 與 layover 捏造連鎖飯店。
• 單字補充：airport club (n.) 機場貴賓室會員計畫。

questions.q: What benefit is highlighted for frequent flyers?
options: Complimentary early-morning flight rebooking
Dedicated private workspaces at over 400 hotels
Unrestricted use of private bathing facilities
Discounted chef-prepared meals at airport cafés

explain.text:
• 考點：會員福利（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 unlimited access to private shower suites，正解 (C) 改寫為 Unrestricted use of private bathing facilities。
• 誘答分析：(D) 混用 chef-prepared hot meals 與 cafés；(A) 混用 early morning flight；(B) 混用 private workspaces 與 400。
• 單字補充：unrestricted (adj.) 無限制的。

questions.q: How can listeners receive a waived initiation fee?
options: By booking an international flight through horizonelite.com
By paying a $150 deposit with promo code ELITE26
By visiting one of the 400 lounges during a layover
By enrolling prior to the close of the current month

explain.text:
• 考點：優惠條件（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 sign up before the end of the month，正解 (D) 改寫為 By enrolling prior to the close of the current month。
• 誘答分析：(A) 挪用 horizonelite.com；(B) 混用 $150 與 ELITE26（$150 是被免除的入會費而非押金）；(C) 混用 400 lounges 與 layover。
• 單字補充：enroll (v.) 註冊加入。

questions.q: What is the report mainly about?
options: Daytime flight cancellations on Runway 2
Postponed facility work at an aviation hub
A September strike affecting steel suppliers
Higher summer ticket prices across commercial airlines

explain.text:
• 考點：新聞主旨（同義替換）。
• 解析：報導主軸為 Construction delays on the new Terminal 4 expansion 延後至十二月完工，對應 (B) Postponed facility work at an aviation hub。
• 誘答分析：(C) 挪用 September 與 steel supply 捏造罷工；(D) 挪用 summer ticket prices（僅為節目預告訪談主題）；(A) 混用 Runway 2（白天航班不受影響）。
• 單字補充：aviation hub (n.) 航空樞紐。

questions.q: What did airport officials announce yesterday?
options: Overnight airfield repairs will start in early summer.
Steel supply shortages will delay daytime flights in June.
Terminal 4 will partially open in September.
Summer airfare queues will be shorter after the break.

explain.text:
• 考點：昨日公告細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 nighttime runway maintenance on Runway 2 will begin in June，正解 (A) 改寫為 Overnight airfield repairs will start in early summer。
• 誘答分析：(C) 原文已延後至十二月；(B) 混用 steel supply shortages 與 June；(D) 混用 longer queues 與 summer。
• 單字補充：airfield (n.) 機場跑道與停機坪區域。

questions.q: Who will be interviewed next on the program?
options: A commercial pilot operating on Runway 2
A specialist in air travel economics
A construction contractor for Terminal 4
A Metro International Airport spokesperson

explain.text:
• 考點：下一位受訪者（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 aviation industry analyst Dr. Raymond Cho，正解 (B) 改寫為 A specialist in air travel economics。
• 誘答分析：(D) 挪用 Metro International Airport；(C) 挪用 Terminal 4；(A) 挪用 commercial 與 Runway 2。
• 單字補充：specialist (n.) 專家。

questions.q: What is the speaker explaining to new employees?
options: How to manage situations where ticket sales exceed seat capacity
How to process meal refunds at airport restaurants
How to deny boarding to passengers without reservations
How to train duty managers on Day 2 of onboarding

explain.text:
• 考點：演講主題（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 how to handle overbooked flights，正解 (A) 改寫為 How to manage situations where ticket sales exceed seat capacity。
• 誘答分析：(C) 原文先徵求志願者而非直接拒載；(B) 挪用 meal vouchers 與 airport restaurants；(D) 混用 duty managers 與 Day 2。
• 單字補充：exceed capacity (phr.) 超出容納上限。

questions.q: What does the speaker emphasize about the vouchers?
options: Volunteers must redeem them before leaving the gate.
Gate agents must sign every voucher before handing it out.
High-value certificates require managerial authorization.
Meal vouchers can only be used for amounts under $300.

explain.text:
• 考點：強調規定（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 every voucher over $300 must be signed by a duty manager，正解 (C) 改寫為 High-value certificates require managerial authorization。
• 誘答分析：(D) 混用 meal vouchers 與 $300；(A) 挪用 volunteers 與 gate；(B) 過度推論「每張」皆須由地勤簽名。
• 單字補充：authorization (n.) 授權核准。

questions.q: What will the listeners do immediately after the talk?
options: Practice handling volunteers at an actual departure gate
Act out customer scenarios with a partner
Draft a new onboarding script for oversold flights
Meet with a duty manager to review voucher rules

explain.text:
• 考點：會後行動（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 pair up and complete a short role-playing exercise，正解 (B) 改寫為 Act out customer scenarios with a partner。
• 誘答分析：(A) 過度推論去實際登機門；(C) 挪用 script 與 oversold flights；(D) 挪用 duty manager。
• 單字補充：act out (phr.) 演練、扮演。

questions.q: Why is the speaker calling Ms. Tanaka?
options: To reschedule a marketing seminar to next month
To explain why downtown occupancy reached 95 percent
To introduce the hotel's new revenue director
To follow up on group lodging pricing and adjacent accommodations

explain.text:
• 考點：來電目的（同義替換）。
• 解析：說話者回報團體房價 $215 無法再降，並保留了兩間相連套房，對應 (D) To follow up on group lodging pricing and adjacent accommodations。
• 誘答分析：(B) 挪用 downtown occupancy 與 95 percent；(A) 挪用 marketing seminar；(C) 挪用 revenue director。
• 單字補充：adjacent (adj.) 相鄰的。

questions.q: What does the speaker say when she mentions, "That's the best we can do during peak convention week"?
options: The quoted nightly tariff is not open to further reduction.
Executive directors must pay more than $215 per night.
The hotel cannot hold the room block past noon tomorrow.
Standard rooms will sell out before the marketing seminar.

explain.text:
• 考點：語意推論題（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文提及詢問營收總監是否能再降價，結論是 $215 per night is honestly the best we can do，對應 (A) The quoted nightly tariff is not open to further reduction。
• 誘答分析：(C) 混用 noon tomorrow；(B) 反向陷阱，原文明確說套房維持同價；(D) 挪用 marketing seminar。
• 單字補充：tariff (n.) 價目表、費率。

questions.q: What is Ms. Tanaka asked to do by noon tomorrow?
options: Speak directly with the hotel's revenue director
Pay the $215 per night rate for the entire room block
Let the hotel know whether to keep the adjoining suites
Submit a list of executive directors attending the seminar

explain.text:
• 考點：要求回覆事項（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 call back by noon tomorrow to confirm whether you want those connecting rooms，正解 (C) 改寫為 Let the hotel know whether to keep the adjoining suites。
• 誘答分析：(A) 挪用 revenue director；(D) 挪用 executive directors；(B) 挪用 $215 per night。
• 單字補充：adjoining (adj.) 毗鄰相通的。

questions.q: Who is most likely giving this presentation?
options: A travel reimbursement auditor
A commercial airline ticket agent
A client meeting coordinator
A company purchasing manager

explain.text:
• 考點：說話者身分（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文開頭自稱 corporate procurement officer（企業採購官），對應 (D) A company purchasing manager。
• 誘答分析：(B) 誤以為是航空公司業務；(C) 挪用 client 與 meeting；(A) 過度推論。
• 單字補充：procurement (n.) 採購。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which fare tier does the speaker recommend for employees taking short, unpredictable client trips?
options: Business Premier
Economy Flex
Economy Standard
Economy Lite

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表交叉比對題（必須聽線索 + 看票價表）。
• 解析：講者未直接唸出票價等級名稱，僅提示針對臨時變動的短程差旅，應選擇「修改行程免收手續費的經濟艙方案（the economy option that doesn't charge a penalty for itinerary modifications）」。對照圖表，Change Fee: Waived 的經濟艙方案唯有 Economy Flex，故選 (B)。
• 誘答分析：(D) 不可改票；(C) 改票需 $75；(A) 為商務艙而非經濟艙方案。
• 單字補充：waive (v.) 免除。

questions.q: What does the speaker say will happen next quarter?
options: Travelers will lose unused credits from canceled tickets.
Business Premier will be restricted to international client trips.
Employees will no longer be charged $75 for seat changes.
Remaining funds from voided bookings will be consolidated for company use.

explain.text:
• 考點：未來政策變動（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 unused travel credits from canceled tickets will automatically be pooled at the corporate level，正解 (D) 改寫為 Remaining funds from voided bookings will be consolidated for company use。
• 誘答分析：(C) 挪用圖表 $75；(A) 反向陷阱，未使用額度是「集中保留」而非「損失」；(B) 挪用 Business Premier。
• 單字補充：consolidate (v.) 合併集中；voided (adj.) 作廢取消的。

questions.q: Who is the speaker addressing?
options: Unpaid event helpers
Panel discussion moderators
Aviation technology exhibitors
VIP pass holders

explain.text:
• 考點：聽眾對象（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文開頭感謝大家 volunteering at this year's Aviation Tech Expo，對應 (A) Unpaid event helpers。
• 誘答分析：(C)(D)(B) 皆為活動會場內出現的對象，屬身分混淆陷阱。
• 單字補充：volunteer (n./v.) 志工／自願服務。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Where should attendees go if they have not yet received their credentials?
options: Zone B
Zone A
Zone D
Zone C

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表交叉比對題（必須聽地點 + 看區域表）。
• 解析：講者未直接唸出區域名稱，僅指示尚未領取識別證（badges）的與會者前往 the North Atrium。對照活動地圖表格，North Atrium 對應的是 Zone A，故選 (B)。
• 誘答分析：(A)(D)(C) 皆為圖表上的其他區域，但地點與功能皆不符。
• 單字補充：credential (n.) 證件、識別證。

questions.q: What is scheduled to take place at 5:30 P.M.?
options: An evening social gathering for special pass holders
Doors opening at the North Atrium
A closing tour of the Main Exhibition Hall
A panel discussion on the Mezzanine Level

explain.text:
• 考點：活動時間細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 evening reception will take place at 5:30 P.M. 並針對 VIP 通行證持有者，正解 (A) 改寫為 An evening social gathering for special pass holders。
• 誘答分析：(B) 開門時間為 9:00 A.M.，與 North Atrium 混用；(D) 挪用 Mezzanine Level 與 panel discussion；(C) 挪用 Main Exhibition Hall。
• 單字補充：social gathering (n.) 社交聚會／酒會。

questions.q: All international passengers must present a valid passport and boarding pass ------- entering the security screening area.
options: regardless of
in spite of
prior to
as soon as

explain.text:
prior to
• 考點：介系詞片語辨析。
• 解析：空格後接動名詞 entering，需填入介系詞。"prior to + V-ing" 表「在……之前」，符合「進入安檢區前須出示護照與登機證」。
• 誘答分析：(B) 儘管；(D) 一……就（為連接詞，後須接完整子句）；(A) 不論。
• 單字補充：screening area (n.) 安檢區。

questions.q: The Silvercrest Grand Hotel recently underwent a multimillion-dollar ------- to modernize its conference suites and rooftop lounge.
options: renovated
renovation
renovate
renovating

explain.text:
renovation
• 考點：詞性判斷（名詞）。
• 解析：空格前有不定冠詞 a 與複合形容詞 multimillion-dollar，故需填入單數可數名詞 renovation（翻新工程）。
• 誘答分析：(C) 動詞原形；(A) 過去分詞／形容詞；(D) 動名詞／現在分詞。
• 單字補充：modernize (v.) 使現代化。

questions.q: ------- the severe winter storm across the Midwest, Meridian Airlines managed to operate 88 percent of its scheduled departures on time.
options: Whereas
Notwithstanding
Provided that
Even though

explain.text:
Notwithstanding
• 考點：讓步介系詞與連接詞區分。
• 解析：空格後為名詞片語 the severe winter storm across the Midwest，故需選用介系詞。Notwithstanding 表「儘管、雖然」，等於 Despite / In spite of。
• 誘答分析：(C) 倘若（連接詞）；(A) 然而（連接詞）；(D) 雖然（連接詞，後接完整子句）。
• 單字補充：scheduled departure (n.) 預定出發班機。

questions.q: Conference attendees who register before October 15 are ------- for a complimentary harbor dinner cruise.
options: fluent
reluctant
comparative
eligible

explain.text:
eligible
• 考點：形容詞字彙與固定搭配（be eligible for）。
• 解析：be eligible for + 名詞 為多益極高頻搭配，意為「有資格獲得……」。
• 誘答分析：(C) 比較的；(A) 流利的；(B) 不情願的。
• 單字補充：complimentary (adj.) 免費招待的。

questions.q: Ms. Alvarez requested that the catering team ------- the vegetarian entrees separately from the seafood dishes during the banquet.
options: served
serving
serve
serves

explain.text:
serve
• 考點：假設語氣／要求動詞後之原形動詞（Subjunctive）。
• 解析：主要子句動詞為 requested，其後的 that 名詞子句應使用 (should) + 原形動詞，故選 serve。
• 誘答分析：(D) 第三人稱單數現在式；(A) 過去式；(B) 動名詞。
• 單字補充：entree (n.) 主菜（美式用法）。

questions.q: Because the convention shuttle runs every twenty minutes, travelers rarely experience ------- delays between the terminal and downtown hotels.
options: prolonged
prolonging
prolong
prolongation

explain.text:
prolonged
• 考點：分詞形容詞。
• 解析：空格修飾複數名詞 delays，prolonged 表「長時間的、拖延的」，符合語意。
• 誘答分析：(C) 動詞「延長」；(B) 現在分詞表「正在延長某物」；(D) 名詞「延長」。
• 單字補充：terminal (n.) 航廈。

questions.q: Had the travel coordinator booked the group airfare earlier, the company ------- nearly $4,200 in peak-season surcharges.
options: would save
would have saved
will save
has saved

explain.text:
would have saved
• 考點：與過去事實相反的假設語氣倒裝（Had + S + Vpp..., S + would have Vpp）。
• 解析：句首 Had the travel coordinator booked... 為 If the travel coordinator had booked... 的倒裝，與過去事實相反，主句應搭配 would have saved。
• 誘答分析：(C) 未來式；(A) 與現在事實相反；(D) 現在完成式。
• 單字補充：surcharge (n.) 額外費用、附加費。

questions.q: Please ensure that all audiovisual equipment is ------- tested at least two hours prior to the keynote speaker's arrival.
options: thoroughness
thoroughly
more thorough
thorough

explain.text:
thoroughly
• 考點：副詞修飾動詞（過去分詞）。
• 解析：空格位於 is 與過去分詞 tested 之間，須用副詞 thoroughly（徹底地）修飾 tested。
• 誘答分析：(D) 形容詞；(A) 名詞；(C) 形容詞比較級。
• 單字補充：audiovisual (adj.) 視聽的。

questions.q: The boutique resort offers tailored wellness retreats ------- to executives seeking quiet accommodations away from urban noise.
options: catered
to cater
catering
having catered

explain.text:
catering
• 考點：分詞片語作後位修飾（主動語態）。
• 解析：retreats（靜修營／療癒行程）主動「迎合、滿足」（cater to）高階主管的需求，故用現在分詞 catering（相當於 which cater to...）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 過去分詞表被動，但 cater to 為不及物動詞片語，不可用被動修飾 retreats。
• 單字補充：tailored (adj.) 量身打造的；cater to (phr.) 迎合、服務。

questions.q: Under the revised corporate expense policy, employees must submit ------- receipts for any business meal exceeding $35.
options: unanimous
designated
obsolete
itemized

explain.text:
itemized
• 考點：差旅字彙辨析。
• 解析：itemized receipt 意為「分項明細收據」，為企業報帳必備單據。
• 誘答分析：(B) 指定的；(A) 一致通過的；(C) 過時的。
• 單字補充：exceed (v.) 超過。

questions.q: ------- their flight from Frankfurt was delayed by three hours, the engineering delegation still arrived in time for the opening reception.
options: Despite
Although
In case
Because of

explain.text:
Although
• 考點：從屬連接詞（讓步）。
• 解析：空格後接完整子句 their flight from Frankfurt was delayed...，且前後語意轉折，故選連接詞 Although。
• 誘答分析：(A) Despite 與 (D) Because of 皆為介系詞，後不可接完整子句；(C) In case 表「萬一」。
• 單字補充：delegation (n.) 代表團。

questions.q: The airline's loyalty program allows members to ------- accumulated mileage toward cabin upgrades, hotel stays, and car rentals.
options: concede
abstain
preside
redeem

explain.text:
redeem
• 考點：動詞字彙（航空哩程兌換）。
• 解析：redeem 意為「兌換（點數、哩程、優惠券）」，搭配 accumulated mileage toward...（將累積哩程兌換為……）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 承認、讓步；(C) 主持；(B) 棄權、戒除。
• 單字補充：accumulated mileage (n.) 累積哩程。

questions.q: Neither the event director nor the venue coordinators ------- notified about the sudden change in the keynote speaker's travel itinerary.
options: has been
were
was
is being

explain.text:
were
• 考點：對等連接詞主謂一致（Neither A nor B）。
• 解析：Neither A nor B 作主詞時，動詞單複數依最接近的 B 決定。the venue coordinators 為複數，且為被動語態（be notified），故選 were。
• 誘答分析：(C)、(A)、(D) 皆為單數動詞。
• 單字補充：notify (v.) 通知。

questions.q: Guests staying on the executive floor enjoy ------- access to the private sky lounge, which serves refreshments throughout the day.
options: exclusion
exclude
exclusive
exclusively

explain.text:
exclusive
• 考點：形容詞修飾名詞（專屬的）。
• 解析：空格後為名詞 access，exclusive access 意為「專屬使用權／通行權」。
• 誘答分析：(B) 動詞；(A) 名詞；(D) 副詞。
• 單字補充：refreshment (n.) 茶點、點心。

questions.q: The exhibition hall's floor plan was redesigned so that visitors could ------- navigate between the main stage and the vendor booths.
options: efforts
effort
effortlessly
effortless

explain.text:
effortlessly
• 考點：副詞修飾動詞。
• 解析：空格位於助動詞 could 與原形動詞 navigate 之間，須填入副詞 effortlessly（毫不費力地）。
• 誘答分析：(D) 形容詞；(B)/(A) 名詞。
• 單字補充：floor plan (n.) 樓層平面圖。

questions.q: ------- the keynote address concludes at 4:00 P.M., a panel discussion on sustainable aviation fuel will begin in Room 204.
options: Once
Unless
Until
While

explain.text:
Once
• 考點：時間連接詞（一旦……就……）。
• 解析：題意為「一旦主題演講於下午四點結束，關於永續航空燃料的座談會就會在 204 室開始」，選 Once 最精準。
• 誘答分析：(B) 除非；(C) 直到；(D) 當……之時（不合結束後緊接開始的邏輯）。
• 單字補充：sustainable aviation fuel (n.) 永續航空燃料（SAF）。

questions.q: The hospitality group plans to expand its ------- of luxury seaside properties across Southeast Asia over the next five years.
options: portfolio
transcript
itinerary
curriculum

explain.text:
portfolio
• 考點：商業與旅宿字彙。
• 解析：portfolio of properties 指飯店集團旗下的「物業投資組合／旗下飯店陣容」。
• 誘答分析：(C) 行程表；(D) 課程綱要；(B) 文字稿／成績單。
• 單字補充：seaside property (n.) 海濱度假物業。

questions.q: ------- in the historic district, the newly restored Savoy Inn provides convenient walking access to major museums and theaters.
options: To situate
Situates
Situating
Situated

explain.text:
Situated
• 考點：分詞構句（表示地點）。
• 解析：be situated in...（位於……）省略主詞與 be 動詞後，保留過去分詞 Situated 置於句首修飾主詞 the newly restored Savoy Inn。
• 誘答分析：(C) 主動分詞不合邏輯；(A) 不定詞表目的，不合句意；(B) 動詞單數形無法連接主句。
• 單字補充：historic district (n.) 歷史街區。

questions.q: Passengers traveling with oversized musical instruments must make special ------- with the cargo desk at least 48 hours in advance.
options: arrange
arrangements
arranged
arranging

explain.text:
arrangements
• 考點：固定搭配名詞（make arrangements）。
• 解析：make special arrangements with... 意為「與……做特別安排」，為慣用複數名詞搭配。
• 誘答分析：(C) 過去分詞；(D) 動名詞；(A) 原形動詞。
• 單字補充：cargo desk (n.) 貨運／特殊行李櫃檯。

questions.q: The convention's organizing committee expressed ------- appreciation to the volunteers who staffed the information desks all weekend.
options: sincere
sincerity
sincerely
more sincerely

explain.text:
sincere
• 考點：形容詞修飾名詞。
• 解析：空格修飾名詞 appreciation，sincere appreciation（誠摯的謝意）為標準搭配。
• 誘答分析：(C)/(D) 副詞；(B) 名詞。
• 單字補充：organizing committee (n.) 籌備委員會。

questions.q: ------- of the high-speed rail link between the airport and the financial center has significantly reduced commute times for visiting executives.
options: Completing
Complete
Completion
Completely

explain.text:
Completion
• 考點：名詞作主詞。
• 解析：空格位於句首且後接 of the high-speed rail link，主句動詞為 has significantly reduced，需名詞 Completion（完工）作主詞。
• 誘答分析：(B) 形容詞／動詞；(D) 副詞；(A) 動名詞後通常直接接受詞，不接 of。
• 單字補充：commute time (n.) 通勤時間。

questions.q: If your connecting flight is canceled due to inclement weather, our customer care agents will rebook you ------- extra charge.
options: at no
in no
by no
on no

explain.text:
at no
• 考點：固定介系詞片語（at no extra charge）。
• 解析：at no extra charge 為「不另收費、免費」的固定商業用語。
• 誘答分析：(C)、(B)、(D) 介系詞皆不與 extra charge 搭配。
• 單字補充：inclement weather (n.) 惡劣天候。

questions.q: The hotel's concierge desk is staffed round the clock to ------- guests with restaurant reservations, theater tickets, and private transfers.
options: consist
insist
persist
assist

explain.text:
assist
• 考點：動詞字彙與搭配（assist A with B）。
• 解析：assist guests with... 意為「協助房客處理……」。
• 誘答分析：(B) 堅持（常接 on）；(A) 由……組成（of）；(C) 持續、堅持（in）。
• 單字補充：round the clock (phr.) 24 小時全天候。

questions.q: The event planners ------- reviewed the final catering invoice before discovering that the banquet hall had billed them for thirty extra place settings.
options: carefully
careful
carefulness
care

explain.text:
carefully
• 考點：詞性判斷（副詞修飾動詞）。
• 解析：空格位於主詞 The event planners 與過去式動詞 reviewed 之間，須填入副詞 carefully（仔細地）修飾動詞 reviewed。
• 誘答分析：(B) careful 為形容詞；(D) care 為名詞或動詞；(C) carefulness 為名詞。
• 單字補充：place setting (n.) 餐桌上的個人餐具組（或計費人頭份數）。

questions.q: The regional aviation authority issued stricter ------- regarding lithium battery storage in checked luggage following last month's audit.
options: directives
premises
prospects
intervals

explain.text:
directives
• 考點：名詞字彙辨析。
• 解析：航管局針對託運行李鋰電池發布更嚴格的「指令／規範」（directives）。
• 誘答分析：(D) 間隔；(B) 營業場所／前提；(C) 前景。
• 單字補充：lithium battery (n.) 鋰電池。

questions.q: Frequent travelers who enroll in the automated border clearance program can bypass standard immigration queues ------- at twelve participating airports.
options: all together
although
almost
altogether

explain.text:
altogether
• 考點：易混淆副詞辨析（altogether vs. all together）。
• 解析：altogether 意為「完全地、徹底地」（completely），修飾 bypass standard immigration queues（完全免去排一般入境隊伍）。
• 誘答分析：(A) all together 指「全體一起」；(B) 雖然（連接詞）；(C) 幾乎。
• 單字補充：border clearance (n.) 邊境通關。

questions.q: Mr. Kobayashi's presentation on hotel revenue management was ------- well received that the conference organizers invited him back next year.
options: such
so
too
very

explain.text:
so
• 考點：結果子句句型（so + adv. + that...）。
• 解析：well received 為「副詞＋過去分詞（形容詞性）」結構，應搭配 so 形成 so well received that...。
• 誘答分析：(A) such 後須接名詞片語；(D)/(C) very 與 too 不可與 that 結果子句連用。
• 單字補充：revenue management (n.) 收益管理。

questions.q: All exhibitor booths must be completely dismantled and cleared from the exhibition floor ------- 8:00 P.M. on Sunday.
options: by
throughout
until
within

explain.text:
by
• 考點：時間介系詞（by vs. until）。
• 解析：dismantled and cleared（拆除並清空）為一次性完成的截止動作，須搭配表「最遲在……之前」的 by。
• 誘答分析：(C) until 搭配持續性動作；(D) within 後接「一段時間」；(B) throughout 表「貫穿整個期間」。
• 單字補充：dismantle (v.) 拆除、拆解。

questions.q: The airline's newly appointed CEO emphasized that punctuality and transparent communication remain ------- to rebuilding passenger trust.
options: redundant
tentative
paramount
adjacent

explain.text:
paramount
• 考點：高階形容詞字彙。
• 解析：paramount 意為「至關重要的、首要的」，搭配 remain paramount to...。
• 誘答分析：(A) 多餘的；(B) 暫定的；(D) 鄰近的。
• 單字補充：punctuality (n.) 準時。

questions.q: ------- whether the trade delegation arrives on Tuesday or Wednesday, the protocol office has reserved suites at the Regent Plaza for the entire week.
options: Even if
On behalf of
In addition to
Regardless of

explain.text:
Regardless of
• 考點：介系詞片語接名詞子句（whether... or...）。
• 解析：Regardless of whether A or B 意為「無論是 A 還是 B」，接 whether 引導的名詞子句。
• 誘答分析：(A) Even if 後不接 whether；(C) 除了……之外；(B) 代表……。
• 單字補充：protocol office (n.) 禮賓辦公室。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (131).
options: Among
Throughout
Beside
Toward

explain.text:
Throughout
• 考點：時間介系詞。
• 解析：指「在這個為期六個月的工程期間」，使用 Throughout（貫穿整個……期間）最貼切。
• 誘答分析：(A) 在……之中；(C) 在……旁邊；(D) 朝向。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (132).
options: Signage has been posted along all concourses to guide travelers to the new counters.
The airport's duty-free shops will extend their operating hours until midnight.
Checked baggage allowances will remain unchanged for international routes.
Parking fees in the long-term garage are discounted for loyalty members.

explain.text:
• 考點：句子插入題（語意連貫）。
• 解析：前句提醒旅客提早兩半小時抵達（因櫃檯搬遷至第一航廈 C 區），後句說明航廈間免費接駁車。(A)「所有大廳均已設置指示牌引導旅客前往新櫃檯」完美銜接報到指引。
• 誘答分析：(C) 託運行李額度、(B) 免稅店營業時間、(D) 長期停車費皆偏離櫃檯搬遷主題。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (133).
options: regret
regrettably
regretful
regretting

explain.text:
regret
• 考點：動詞時態與詞性。
• 解析：主詞為 We，與對等動詞 and appreciate 並列，須用現在簡單式原形動詞 regret（對……深表遺憾／抱歉）。
• 單字補充：temporary adjustment (n.) 暫時性調整。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (134).
options: consultation
consult
consulted
consulting

explain.text:
consult
• 考點：祈使句動詞原形。
• 解析：please 後接原形動詞 consult（查閱）。
• 單字補充：real-time (adj.) 即時的。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (135).
options: In contrast
By means of
In addition
On account

explain.text:
In addition
• 考點：轉折語與固定搭配（In addition to）。
• 解析：空格後已有 to，In addition to（除了……之外）符合「除了每日折扣房價，還包含免費 Wi-Fi 與早餐」。
• 誘答分析：(A) 相較之下（與 to 連用表對比，不合語意）；(B) 藉由（接 of）；(D) 因為（接 of）。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (136).
options: Several regional offices have already exceeded their Q2 travel budgets.
Employees must submit expense reports within ten business days of returning.
These negotiated benefits are expected to save the firm over $180,000 annually.
The previous contract with Harbourfront Inn expired at the end of last year.

explain.text:
• 考點：句子插入題。
• 解析：本段列舉各項企業協議優惠，結尾處 (C)「這些議定的福利預計每年為公司節省超過 18 萬美元」自然總結合作案的財務效益。
• 誘答分析：(D) 舊約過期、(A) 預算超支、(B) 報帳期限皆與該段主旨不符。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (137).
options: eligible
ineligible
eligibility
eligibly

explain.text:
eligible
• 考點：詞性與語意（not be eligible for）。
• 解析：句中已有 not，故需肯定形容詞 eligible（有資格的），構成「將不具備資格享有優惠」。
• 誘答分析：(B) ineligible 若填入會造成雙重否定，語意相反。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (138).
options: from
onto
with
for

explain.text:
for
• 考點：介系詞搭配（for assistance）。
• 解析：contact [某人/單位] for assistance（聯繫……尋求協助）為固定用法。
• 單字補充：direct billing (n.) 公司直接掛帳付款。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (139).
options: Owing
Due
Prior
In addition

explain.text:
In addition
• 考點：介系詞片語（In addition to + 名詞）。
• 解析：空格後是 to traditional lecture formats，In addition to（除了……之外）表示在傳統演講之外，今年再加入互動式圓桌會議，語意通順。
• 誘答分析：(A) Owing to、(B) Due to（由於）因果關係不合；(C) Prior to（在……之前）語意不合。
• 單字補充：roundtable (n.) 圓桌會議；contactless (adj.) 非接觸式的。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (140).
options: Public transit passes are included with every hotel reservation in the city center.
Local taxi drivers have protested rising fuel prices near the convention district.
Last year's keynote speaker published a bestselling memoir about luxury resorts.
Organizers are also expanding the trade floor to accommodate fifty additional exhibitors.

explain.text:
• 考點：句子插入題。
• 解析：空格後緊接著說明 A 館展覽攤位已售出 95%，(D)「主辦單位也正擴大展覽區以容納額外五十家參展商」直接帶出攤位熱銷的上下文。
• 誘答分析：(B) 計程車抗議、(C) 講者回憶錄、(A) 交通卡優惠皆無關展覽攤位。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (141).
options: uninvited
unfulfilled
unprecedented
unintended

explain.text:
unprecedented
• 考點：形容詞字彙。
• 解析：配合攤位售出 95%，unprecedented interest 意為「前所未有的濃厚興趣」。
• 誘答分析：(A) 未受邀的；(D) 無意的；(B) 未實現的。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (142).
options: since
during
until
between

explain.text:
until
• 考點：時間介系詞（截止日期）。
• 解析：remain open until October 10（早鳥優惠開放至十月十日止）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 自從（須配完成式）；(B) 在……期間（後接時段而非特定日期）；(D) 在……之間（需有 and）。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (143).
options: appeal
adhere
assign
adapt

explain.text:
adhere
• 考點：動詞搭配（adhere to）。
• 解析：adhere strictly to [protocol/rules] 意為「嚴格遵守規定」。
• 誘答分析：(A) 呼籲／吸引；(C) 指派；(D) 適應。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (144).
options: The hotel's main dining room will close at 10:30 P.M. on Sundays.
This separation prevents accidental cross-contamination during peak service hours.
Our pastry chef recently won a national award for artisan sourdough bread.
Guests may request a copy of the wine list from their table server.

explain.text:
• 考點：句子插入題。
• 解析：前句規定過敏原餐點必須在專用區使用分色廚具製作，(B)「這項區隔可防止尖峰出餐時段發生意外交叉污染」解釋該規定的目的。
• 單字補充：cross-contamination (n.) 交叉污染。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (145).
options: Furthermore
Nevertheless
Consequently
Otherwise

explain.text:
Furthermore
• 考點：連接副詞（遞進補充）。
• 解析：前段講廚房端查核貼標籤，本句補充外場服務生上菜前的口頭確認步驟，故用 Furthermore（此外）。
• 誘答分析：(C) 因此；(D) 否則；(B) 然而。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (146).
options: optional
temporary
voluntary
compulsory

explain.text:
compulsory
• 考點：形容詞字彙（強制性的）。
• 解析：前句提到 A mandatory 30-minute refresher training session（強制性複訓），故此處同義替換為 compulsory（強制的、必修的）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 選修的；(B) 暫時的；(C) 自願的。

questions.q: Who is permitted to enter the lounge with Ms. Rostova using this pass?
options: Multiple guests holding same-day boarding passes
Any frequent flyer departing on December 31
A single traveling companion sharing her itinerary
Any SkyAlliance partner carrier employee

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：條款第一點寫道 named pass holder plus one accompanying guest traveling on the same flight，正解 (C) 將 one accompanying guest 替換為 A single traveling companion，on the same flight 替換為 sharing her itinerary。
• 誘答分析：(D) 混用 SkyAlliance partner carrier；(B) 混用 December 31（效期而非限定出發日）；(A) 原文限帶「一位」同行者，非多位。
• 單字補充：accompanying (adj.) 隨行的；itinerary (n.) 行程。

questions.q: What is stated about the lounge's shower suites?
options: They are assigned in the order travelers request them.
They must be reserved at the reception desk prior to arrival.
They are excluded from complimentary single-day admission.
They cannot be used by passengers flying on SkyAlliance partners.

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：條款最後一點指出淋浴間採 first-come, first-served basis，正解 (A) 改寫為 assigned in the order travelers request them（依旅客抵達／請求順序分配）。
• 誘答分析：(B) 原文是入場時於櫃檯詢問，無須事前預約；(D) 原文說明搭乘合作航空亦可使用貴賓室；(C) 原文為 Complimentary（免費）。
• 單字補充：first-come, first-served (phr.) 先到先得。

questions.q: Why was the freight truck initially stopped at Gate 4?
options: The display panels were shipped to the wrong venue gate.
Marcus arrived at Gate 4 before 10:12 A.M. without his tablet.
Gate personnel lacked documentation authorizing the delivery.
The Expo Operations Office had not yet issued the PDF permit.

explain.text:
• 考點：原因細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：Marcus 說 venue security guard says our unloading permit isn't on his list，正解 (C) 改寫為 Gate personnel lacked documentation authorizing the delivery。
• 誘答分析：(D) Priya 昨天下午就已收到 PDF 許可證；(B) Marcus 有帶平板（Priya 說寄給他用平板出示）；(A) 地點就是 Gate 4，問題出在名單未更新。
• 單字補充：authorize (v.) 授權核准。

questions.q: What does Priya instruct Marcus to do about the carpet?
options: Ask the Expo Operations Office to swap it out tomorrow morning
Adjust the lighting rig so the navy blue color stands out
Reject the shipment and install only the main banner
Retain the delivered flooring despite the unexpected shade

explain.text:
• 考點：行動指示（同義替換）。
• 解析：Priya 說 No, keep it... there isn't time to swap it out，雖然顏色是深灰而非海軍藍，仍決定留用，正解 (D) 改寫為 Retain the delivered flooring despite the unexpected shade。
• 誘答分析：(A) 與原文「沒時間更換」相反；(B) 燈光是用來打亮主橫幅（highlights our main banner），非改變地毯顏色；(C) 混用 reject 與 main banner。
• 單字補充：shade (n.) 色調。

questions.q: What must guests do to qualify for the complimentary tea ceremony?
options: Request a round-trip taxi transfer from Kyoto Station
Schedule an uninterrupted multi-night stay prior to October
Enter promo code MERIDIAN26 at the hotel front desk upon arrival
Dine at Chef Haruka Mori's dining room during the inaugural season

explain.text:
• 考點：條件細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 book a minimum stay of three consecutive nights before September 30，正解 (B) 將 three consecutive nights 改寫為 uninterrupted multi-night stay，before September 30 改寫為 prior to October。
• 誘答分析：(A) 計程車接送是贈品而非條件；(D) 混用 Chef Haruka Mori；(C) 優惠碼須於官網（via our website）預訂使用，非抵達櫃檯才輸入。

questions.q: What happens if a Basic Economy passenger brings a full-sized carry-on to the gate without an upgrade?

questions.q: Why did Jonathan K. visit the city?

questions.q: What caused the problem at the breakfast buffet on Tuesday?

An early morning seminar delayed the concierge's shift.
The mobile key system prevented guests from entering on time.

questions.q: What is the main topic of the article?
options: A RATA report criticizing boarding delays in Austin and Portland
Why major international hubs spent five years testing facial-recognition gates
Growing implementation of automated identity-scan boarding at smaller airfields
New 24-hour privacy regulations enforced by North American airlines

explain.text:
• 考點：文章主旨（同義替換）。
• 解析：首段指出 mid-sized regional airports are now rapidly adopting similar biometric boarding systems，正解 (C) 改寫為 Growing implementation of automated identity-scan boarding at smaller airfields。
• 誘答分析：(B) 僅為首句對比背景；(A) Austin 與 Portland 試驗顯示登機變快而非延誤；(D) 隱私倡議者是「呼籲」而非「強制執法」。
• 單字補充：implementation (n.) 實施、導入。

questions.q: According to Victor Morales, what has made biometric systems more affordable for smaller airports?
options: Internet-hosted licensing arrangements that reduce initial equipment outlays
Shared hardware trials conducted in Austin and Portland
A 60 percent government subsidy from RATA
A 42 percent reduction in passenger processing times

explain.text:
• 考點：引述細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：Victor Morales 指出 cloud-based software subscriptions have lowered upfront hardware expenses by nearly 60 percent，正解 (A) 改寫為 Internet-hosted licensing arrangements that reduce initial equipment outlays。

questions.q: What concern do privacy advocates raise?

Traveler biometric records should be purged shortly after flights leave.
Automated boarding lanes may take longer than 28 minutes for large planes.

• 誘答分析：(A) 與原文成本下降 60% 相反；(D) 試驗結果顯示登機時間縮短；(B) 過度推論。
• 單字補充：purge (v.) 清除、刪除。

questions.q: Why is the company dividing the sales team into two shifts?

To reduce booth coverage on April 15 by 25 percent
To ensure all eight representatives work together on April 14 and April 16
To maximize mid-event staffing while cutting lodging and meal expenditures

• 解析：政策規定商務艙 requires prior written approval from a Managing Partner and is restricted to flights over 9 hours，正解 (B) 改寫為 limited to long-haul trips and need senior executive sign-off。
• 誘答分析：(A) 超過 6 小時免核准的是豪華經濟艙（Premium Economy）；(D) 三人同行規定適用於私人轎車接送；(C) 11:00 P.M.–5:00 A.M. 亦為轎車接送條件。
• 單字補充：long-haul (adj.) 長途飛行的；sign-off (n.) 簽核批准。

questions.q: Why was Rachel Kim's hotel stay at the Shinjuku Meridian Hotel approved?
options: A Managing Partner granted an exception for her four-night stay.
Her destination is a top-tier market and the room cost fell under the ceiling.
Her nightly rate was below the $220 cap for regional hubs.
Taxes and resort fees were excluded by the Shinjuku Meridian Hotel.

explain.text:
• 考點：跨文件因果推論（同義替換）。
• 解析：政策將東京列為 Tier-1 樞紐城市（上限 $310/night），Rachel 住宿費為 $295/night，未超標故獲准。正解 (B) 改寫為 destination is a top-tier market and the room cost fell under the ceiling。
• 誘答分析：(D) 稅金本就不計入上限，非飯店免除；(A) 無須特別核准；(C) $220 是 Tier-2 城市上限。
• 單字補充：ceiling (n.) 價格上限。

questions.q: Under what condition would Rachel's $145 private sedan transfer have been fully reimbursed?
options: If she had traveled with one other Kestrel consultant
If the Haneda Monorail had cost more than $25
If she had obtained written VP approval before March 4
If her plane had touched down late at night

explain.text:
• 考點：條件推論（同義替換）。
• 解析：政策規定私人轎車僅在三人以上同行或於 11:00 P.M. and 5:00 A.M. 之間抵達時才可報銷。Rachel 獨自於 3:40 P.M. 抵達，故若班機在深夜降落（touched down late at night）即可全額報銷，選 (D)。
• 誘答分析：(A) 一位同事僅兩人，未達三人門檻；(B) $25 是單筆餐費需附收據門檻；(C) 政策未規定副總核准可用於私人轎車。
• 單字補充：touch down (phr.) （飛機）降落。

questions.q: What is the maximum amount Rachel can be reimbursed for the March 4 airport transfer if no extenuating circumstance is provided?

explain.text:
• 考點：數據細節。
• 解析：審核團隊指出若無特殊理由，僅能依單軌＋JR 特急車票等值金額 $18 報銷，故選 (B)。
• 誘答分析：(A) 並非完全不補助；(C) $85 為每日餐費上限；(D) $145 為實付轎車費用。
• 單字補充：extenuating circumstance (n.) 可寬宥的特殊情況。

questions.q: What must Rachel provide to get the wine on her March 6 dinner receipt reimbursed?
options: Documentation of client hospitality along with leadership authorization
Written approval from a Managing Partner before March 20
Proof that the $112 dinner was shared with two other consultants
A separate receipt showing the food portion was under $85

explain.text:
• 考點：跨文件條件核對（同義替換）。
• 解析：政策規定酒類飲品不可報銷，除非 entertaining a client with VP approval，郵件亦要求註明是否有客戶在場並附上副總核准。正解 (A) 改寫為 Documentation of client hospitality along with leadership authorization。
• 誘答分析：(D) 食物部分超過 $85 仍受每日上限限制；(B) 需 VP 而非 Managing Partner 核准，且 3/20 是更新報告期限；(C) 混用三人同行規定。
• 單字補充：hospitality (n.) 招待、款待。

questions.q: Why was Mei-Ling Zhou's session moved to a different room?
options: The Grand Auditorium became available after an afternoon session moved.
Dr. Thorne's morning keynote ran 15 minutes past 10:15 A.M.
Projected demand exceeded the original hall's seating limit.
Hall 2B's audiovisual equipment could not read her USB backup.

explain.text:
• 考點：原因細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：信中指出 Hall 2B 容量僅 150 人，但有超過 260 人在 App 預約該場次，故改至可容納 500 人的大禮堂。正解 (C) 改寫為 Projected demand exceeded the original hall's seating limit。
• 誘答分析：(B) Dr. Thorne 演講準時於 10:15 結束；(D) 僅要求攜帶 USB 備份，非設備不相容；(A) 過度推論。
• 單字補充：projected demand (n.) 預期需求人數。

questions.q: When is Mei-Ling Zhou asked to arrive at the Grand Auditorium?

explain.text:
• 考點：時間細節。
• 解析：信中明確要求 Please arrive at the Grand Auditorium stage by 10:15 A.M. sharp，故選 (C)。
• 誘答分析：(A) 08:30 A.M. 為推播通知時間；(B) 09:00 A.M. 為開場演講時間；(D) 10:30 A.M. 為原定開講時間。
• 單字補充：switch (v.) 切換。

questions.q: Which session will take place in Hall 2B as originally planned?
options: Regional Hub Expansion in Southeast Asia
Next-Gen Sustainable Jet Fuels
Managing Turnaround Times at Congested Gates
AI-Driven Baggage Routing Systems

explain.text:
• 考點：跨文件狀態追蹤。
• 解析：信末明確指出 the afternoon session in Hall 2B ("Managing Turnaround Times at Congested Gates") will remain in Hall 2B as scheduled，故選 (C)。
• 誘答分析：(B)(D) 在 Grand Auditorium；(A) 在 Hall 2A。
• 單字補充：turnaround time (n.) 航班過站周轉時間。

questions.q: Why was Carlos Vega's 13:00 session rescheduled?
options: Hall 2A was reassigned to the Closing Panel.
Attendees were still at the Level 1 Food Court until 14:30
Fewer than 150 attendees bookmarked his session in the app.
His air travel from Spain experienced a setback.

explain.text:

• 解析：App 推播指出 Carlos Vega's flight from Madrid was delayed overnight，正解 (D) 改寫為 His air travel from Spain experienced a setback。
• 誘答分析：(B) 美食街開放至 14:30，與改期無關；(A) Hall 2A 未被閉幕座談佔用；(C) 260 人預約的是 Mei-Ling 的場次。
• 單字補充：setback (n.) 挫折、延誤。

questions.q: What will happen at 16:00 on May 15?
options: Priya Nair's session in Hall 2B will conclude.
Two scheduled events will overlap in different venues.
Mei-Ling Zhou will join multiple panelists in the Grand Auditorium.
The Food Court on Level 1 will close for the afternoon.

explain.text:
• 考點：跨文件時間推論（同義替換）。
• 解析：Carlos Vega 延後至 16:00 在 Hall 2A 演講，running concurrently with the Closing Panel in the Grand Auditorium，正解 (B) 改寫為 Two scheduled events will overlap in different venues。
• 誘答分析：(D) 美食街於 14:30 關閉；(C)(A) 皆與時程表不符。
• 單字補充：concurrently (adv.) 同時地；overlap (v.) 重疊。

questions.q: Why was Flight AC 218 canceled?
options: Airport transfers at London Heathrow were suspended.
Terminal 3 restaurants were closed for overnight maintenance.
The rebooked flight AC 224 needed an extra crew from JFK.
An unexpected mechanical issue required repair.

explain.text:
• 考點：原因細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：警示單註明取消原因為 Unscheduled Hydraulic Maintenance（計畫外液壓系統維修），正解 (D) 改寫為 An unexpected mechanical issue required repair。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(A) 皆挪用文中出現的 Terminal 3、AC 224、airport transfers 製造字面陷阱。
• 單字補充：hydraulic (adj.) 液壓的。

questions.q: Why did David Lindholm NOT receive a complimentary hotel room?
options: He arrived at JFK before 9:00 P.M. local time.
His replacement flight left without requiring an overnight wait.
His delay was less than the 4-hour minimum threshold.
His £25 meal voucher replaced the hotel accommodation benefit.

explain.text:
• 考點：因果細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：確認單備註指出 Because AC 224 departs on the same calendar day, overnight hotel accommodation is not applicable，正解 (B) 改寫為 His replacement flight left without requiring an overnight wait。
• 誘答分析：(D) 餐券與住宿為獨立補償項目；(C) 延誤達 6 小時 50 分，已超過 4 小時門檻；(A) 抵達 JFK 為 21:05（晚上九點後）。
• 單字補充：not applicable (phr.) 不適用。

questions.q: How long after his original scheduled departure did Mr. Lindholm's new flight depart?
options: 4 hours
6 hours and 50 minutes
7 hours and 15 minutes
9 hours and 5 minutes

explain.text:
• 考點：時間計算細節。
• 解析：原班機 AC 218 為 11:20 A.M.，改訂班機 AC 224 為 18:10，兩者相距 6 hours and 50 minutes（郵件中亦直接提及），故選 (B)。
• 誘答分析：(A) 為餐券資格門檻；(C)(D) 為干擾計算。
• 單字補充：subsequent (adj.) 隨後的。

questions.q: What is Mr. Lindholm requesting a refund for in his email?
options: The £25 meal voucher sent to his mobile app
The cost of the missed client welcome dinner in Manhattan
The fare difference between AC 218 and AC 224
A pre-paid charge for upgraded cabin seating

explain.text:

• 解析：David 在信中要求退還原預訂 14A 加大伸腿空間座位的 £65 選位費（full refund of that seat fee），正解 (D) 改寫為 A pre-paid charge for upgraded cabin seating。
• 誘答分析：(B) 雖錯過曼哈頓客戶晚宴，但信中請求退費的是選位費與法定延誤賠償；(A) 餐券已使用／感念收到；(C) 兩班機皆為 Economy Flex，無票價差額。
• 單字補充：statutory (adj.) 法定的。

questions.q: What can be inferred about Seat 22C on Flight AC 224?
options: It was located in an exit row with extra legroom.
It was upgraded from Economy Flex to Business Class.
It cost £65 more than Seat 14A on AC 218.
It lacked the additional space Mr. Lindholm had purchased.

explain.text:

• 解析：原文說明 Seat 14A 為 extra-legroom exit-row seat，而 Seat 22C 僅為 standard middle-section aisle seat with regular legroom，可推論 (D) lacked the additional space Mr. Lindholm had purchased。
• 誘答分析：(A) 14A 才在逃生門排；(C) £65 是 14A 的選位費；(B) 兩者皆為 Economy Flex。
• 單字補充：legroom (n.) 腿部伸展空間。

questions.q: According to the manual, what is already included in a Standard Booth Package?

Charcoal carpet and a locking reception counter
Two high-back bar stools and freight drayage
Dividers, identification signage, and basic electricity

• 解析：手冊說明標準攤位包含 white partition walls, booth ID sign, and one 110V/5A electrical outlet，正解 (D) 改寫為 Dividers, identification signage, and basic electricity。
• 誘答分析：(B)(A)(C) 所列地毯、櫃檯、有線網路與高腳椅皆為「不包含」需額外加購項目。
• 單字補充：partition (n.) 隔板；signage (n.) 標示牌。

questions.q: Why did Summit Retail Systems pay $870.00 instead of receiving the 20 percent discount on Order #EX-772?
options: The request was placed past the early-bird cutoff.
The order was submitted on August 29, incurring a surcharge.
The 20 percent discount does not cover IT-401 Ethernet drops.
The company ordered fewer than three bar stools.

explain.text:
• 考點：跨文件因果推論（同義替換）。
• 解析：訂單日期為 August 18，已過 August 10 早鳥八折期限，故適用標準費率 $870.00。正解 (A) 改寫為 The request was placed past the early-bird cutoff。
• 誘答分析：(C) 折扣無品項限制；(D) 數量與折扣無關；(B) 8/29 是加訂一張高腳椅的寄信日。
• 單字補充：cutoff (n.) 截止期限。

questions.q: Including the 30 percent on-site/late surcharge (since it is now after August 25), how much will the single extra High-Back Bar Stool (FN-210) cost?

explain.text:
• 考點：跨文件價格計算。
• 解析：High-Back Bar Stool (FN-210) 標準單價為 $65.00。8 月 25 日後加購需加收 30% 遲交／現場附加費：65 × 1.30 = $84.50，故選 (C)。
• 誘答分析：(A) 未加收 30%；(B) 為八折誤算或錯誤加成；(D) 為原訂單兩張的總價。
• 單字補充：surcharge (n.) 附加費。

questions.q: Why can Summit Retail Systems NOT send its demonstration unit crate to the Advanced Warehouse on August 30?
options: Order #EX-772 did not include freight drayage services.
The warehouse does not accept heavy crates from customs.
The facility's receiving deadline will have already passed.
Loading Dock B requires all shipments to arrive on August 28.

explain.text:

• 解析：手冊規定貨物送達 Advanced Warehouse 的截止日為 August 28，而貨運商要到 August 30 才送達，已過收貨期限。正解 (C) 改寫為 The facility's receiving deadline will have already passed。
• 誘答分析：(B) 8/10 是早鳥訂購截止日；(D) Loading Dock B 是在 9/2（進場日）收貨；(A) 貨物遲到係因海關延誤，非訂單漏訂。
• 單字補充：drayage (n.) 展場貨物短程搬運／進場託運費。

questions.q: What does Hannah Brooks ask the Expo Operations Team to confirm?
options: The exact location of the Advanced Warehouse before August 30
The move-in day schedule for a specific unloading bay
Whether the 30 percent surcharge applies to Item FN-210
Whether her third specialist can receive a discounted exhibitor badge

explain.text:
• 考點：寫信請求（同義替換）。
• 解析：Hannah 信末請求 confirm the exact hours that Loading Dock B will be open on September 2（9/2 為手冊上的 move-in day），正解 (B) 改寫為 The move-in day schedule for a specific unloading bay。
• 誘答分析：(D)(C)(A) 皆挪用文中出現的 third specialist、30 percent surcharge、Advanced Warehouse 製造干擾。
• 單字補充：unloading bay (n.) 卸貨碼頭／月台。
